T: A long time ago, in a dinner far, far away.
D: A farm boy joins a rebellion to rescue a princess and destroy the Death Star.
P: Serve the blue milk at the Lars homestead breakfast table.
S: Mos Eisley cantina smoky snack mix
Pretzels, rice crackers, chickpeas and nuts baked with smoky butter

Pretzels, rice crackers, roasted chickpeas and mixed nuts tossed in butter with smoked paprika, garlic, chilli and brown sugar, baked crunchy. Toss 100g pretzels, 100g rice crackers, 100g roasted chickpeas and 150g mixed nuts with 50g melted butter, 1 tsp smoked paprika, half a tsp garlic powder, a pinch of chilli and 1 tbsp brown sugar. Bake at 150C for 25 minutes, stirring twice.
Pork and beef meatballs in a creamy mushroom and Dijon sauce
Pork and beef meatballs baked at 220C for 15 minutes, simmered in a creamy mushroom and Dijon sauce so they come out grey, one thumb dent for the superlaser.
M: Grilled pork sausage, roast pork, pepper slaw and peppercorn sauce in pita

Grill pork sausages, slice roast pork, warm thick pita. Slaw of cabbage, carrot and black pepper in a light mayo dressing. Peppercorn sauce: cracked pepper, shallot, stock and cream reduced. Wrap it all tight.
Tatooine lamb, apricot and chickpea stew

Lamb shoulder braised with cumin, coriander, smoked paprika, tomato, chickpeas and dried apricots until tender, over fluffy couscous with mint. Brown 1.2kg lamb shoulder chunks in batches. Add 2 diced onions and 3 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Stir in 2 tsp cumin, 2 tsp ground coriander, 2 tsp smoked paprika and 2 tbsp tomato paste. Add 400g crushed tomatoes, 500ml stock, a drained 400g tin chickpeas and 100g dried apricots. Cover and braise at 160C for 2.5 hours. Pour 300ml boiling stock over 300g couscous, cover 5 minutes, fluff with butter and serve with mint.
W: Vanilla milk pudding tinted blue, topped with crushed shortbread

Soft vanilla blancmange tinted pale blue like the milk Luke drinks at home, chilled in glasses and topped with crushed shortbread. Whisk 60g cornflour into 100ml of 800ml full cream milk until smooth. Heat the rest of the milk with 80g caster sugar until steaming, then whisk in the cornflour mix and stir over medium heat for 4 minutes until thick. Off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla and a drop of blue food colouring. Pour into 4 glasses and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed shortbread.
K: Cold milk blended with pineapple, lime and blue spirulina, no alcohol
Blend cold milk (or coconut milk) with frozen pineapple, a little dragon fruit, a squeeze of lime and a drop of blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue.

note.text: Don't get cocky. The Falcon flies when she feels like it.

dishes.n: Mos Eisley cantina smoky snack mix

steps.text: Heat the oven to 150C. Toss the pretzels, crackers, chickpeas and nuts with the melted butter and seasonings.
Spread on a lined tray and bake, stirring twice.

dishes.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, keep chilled and reheat gently

steps.text: Season the mince and roll into 20 balls, pressing a thumb dent into each.
Fry the mushrooms in a wide pan, then add the stock, cream and Dijon and simmer.
Add the meatballs and simmer through.
Grill the sausages until cooked through.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and plenty of black pepper.
Reduce the shallot, stock, cream and cracked pepper into a sauce.
Warm the roast pork and the pitas.
Fill the pitas with sausage, pork, slaw and sauce and wrap tightly.
Whisk the cornflour into a little of the cold milk until smooth.
Heat the rest of the milk with the sugar until steaming, then whisk in the cornflour mix and stir until thick.
Off the heat, stir in the vanilla and blue colouring.
Pour into four glasses and chill until set.
Blend the milk, pineapple, lime juice and spirulina until smooth and pale blue.
Add a little honey if you like it sweeter and pour straight away.

s.note: Pretzels, rice crackers, chickpeas and nuts baked with smoky butter

s.note: Pork and beef meatballs in a creamy mushroom and Dijon sauce
s.how: Roll 500g pork and beef mince into 20 balls and press a thumb dent into each. Bake at 220C for 15 minutes. Fry 200g sliced mushrooms, add 200ml stock, 150ml cream and 1 tbsp Dijon and simmer. Add the meatballs and simmer 5 minutes.

m.note: Grilled pork sausage, roast pork, pepper slaw and peppercorn sauce in pita
m.how: Grill 4 pork sausages and warm 300g sliced roast pork. Shred a quarter cabbage and a carrot and toss with mayo and lots of black pepper. Reduce a shallot, 150ml stock and 150ml cream with cracked pepper for sauce. Wrap everything tightly in 4 warm thick pitas.

w.note: Vanilla milk pudding tinted blue, topped with crushed shortbread
w.how: Whisk 60g cornflour into 100ml of 800ml full cream milk until smooth. Heat the rest of the milk with 80g caster sugar until steaming, then whisk in the cornflour mix and stir over medium heat for 4 minutes until thick. Off the heat, add 1 tsp vanilla and a drop of blue food colouring. Pour into 4 glasses and chill 3 hours. Top with crushed shortbread.

d.note: Cold milk blended with pineapple, lime and blue spirulina, no alcohol
d.how: Blend 800ml cold milk with 200g frozen pineapple, the juice of a lime and half a tsp blue spirulina until smooth and pale blue. Add a little honey if you like it sweeter. Pour into four glasses straight away.
